build_progress_bar: build a progress bar wrapper that selects tqdm, json, simple, or noop format based on args.log_format
create_progress_bar_class: create an abstract progress bar base class with log, print, and iteration methods for stats display
create_json_progress_bar: create a progress bar that logs intermediate and end-of-epoch stats as JSON to stdout
create_simple_progress_bar: create a minimal progress bar for non-TTY environments that prints comma-separated stats at intervals
create_tqdm_progress_bar: create a tqdm-based progress bar that updates postfix stats during iteration and prints epoch summaries
